query:
MATCH p = ACYCLIC (src:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(dst:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the caller-selected graph, documented ACYCLIC path mode, post-edge hop quantifier, nodes() and transform(). No DISTINCT or list sorting; parallel-edge path multiplicity is retained. Documentation checked only; not database-executed.
